preliminary_containing_policy_boundary: One SmithingTransformRecipe + SmithingMenu extraction policy; all container/lifecycle/serializer helpers are support0, not six implementations. General inheritance/network/capability internals remain unexpanded.
observations: SmithingTransformRecipe matches template/base/addition Ingredient.test in three fixed slots. It copies the declared result, then if BASE getTag is nonnull it replaces the whole result CompoundTag with a copy of base tag. This is not a key merge or transfer of template/addition tags; a nonnull empty CompoundTag also enters replacement. Result item/count originate in declared result copy; base Forge capability migration is not established by this explicit getTag/setTag code.

If base tag is null, declared result tag remains. getResultItem returns declared recipe result, while assemble can return a different tag because of base override. A displayed/catalog result is therefore not sufficient actual assembled NBT identity proof.

Full Serializer has fixed three Ingredient parse/encode positions and ShapedRecipe.itemStackFromJson for result; network writes declared result via writeItem. The inner Ingredient/Forge parser, share-tag policies and packet path were not reread here, and are not assumed to preserve every unexpanded custom capability.

SmithingMenu constructor caches all smithing recipes for input-slot acceptance and quick-move destination. createResult asks current RecipeManager for currently matching recipes and chooses first, then only publishes if result item enabled by level features. Actual reload interaction/freshness is not tested.

Result mayPickup checks selectedRecipe nonnull and selectedRecipe.matches(current inputs, level). Slot input predicate permits any recipe ingredient for that role, not necessarily all slots jointly matching until createResult/mayPickup. No user quest prerequisite is consulted in these specific classes.

SmithingMenu.onTake calls output onCraftedBy and resultSlots.awardUsedRecipes(player, current three inputs) BEFORE shrinkStackInSlot(0), (1), (2). Each helper shrinks nonempty input by1 and calls setItem, so repeated container changes can recompute preview between debits. No explicit rollback or persistent transaction receipt occurs in these classes; this is not proof of exploit, duplication or failed payment in execution.

ResultContainer stores one result and nullable recipeUsed, and implements RecipeHolder. awardUsedRecipes triggers player.triggerRecipeCrafted even for special recipe, then non-special awards recipe and clears recipeUsed. The overload enforcing limited crafting is distinct and is not the direct setRecipeUsed(recipe) call used by SmithingMenu.createResult. A helper existing in interface does not establish this call-site applied that check.

ItemCombinerMenu owns player from Inventory and proxies result Slot.mayPickup/onTake into menu. Input SimpleContainer.setChanged calls slotsChanged/createResult; removed delegates input clearing to ContainerLevelAccess. stillValid checks block and Forge block reach+3.5. Distant/invalid access and client/server closing effects still require actual native acceptance.

In quickMoveStack, result first attempts moveItemStackTo inventory and returns empty on failure. After transfer it checks change and calls slot.onTake using the remaining mutable result stack; getCount passed by SmithingMenu.onTake therefore cannot alone serve as final output quantity receipt, especially if moved fully. Partial transfer, inherited move, normal click and server packet mechanics were not executed or expanded here.
